replies.author: @maldita-89
replies.text:
Im a Norwegian who have lived there for 4 yrs and seen both sites I don't see this as negative:) 
This documentary is about how the poor live. They are born into a life where everything is about survival. To be able to live like that you have to be strong so have respect for them. Most places you can get a better life if you work hard while there it is often work all day just for a little food. Despite that, the Philippines is known for being a beautiful country with happy people and this does not change that :)

replies.author: @livewithove2all
replies.text: You have to understand and accept the reality of POVERTY in the Philippines that exists TODAY,  it is a FACT. We cannot deny and hide it under the rug, and pretend there's no hardships and just show the luxury for income marketing purposes only so it can attract foreigners to visit. You are right,  there's many well to do and wealthy people in the Philippines. The question is do they just continue to grow their wealth or maybe REMEMBER ONCE IN A WHILE  those who struggle, there's also TRUTH on the less fortunate side of life. Filipinos are good people and happy in general, however many poor ones are forgotten, THEY  LIVE TO SURVIVE, BUT DON'T SURVIVE TO LIVE..... Are you fortunate enough to LIVE comfortably, then what do you do? Maybe in the next series, this blogger may have the chance  to show off the beauty of the Philippines.
